notes_for_editor: Very thin record. Firelookout.ca is the only source that names this tower; it gives the coordinates, the 1963 map confirmation and the southernmost claim, but no type, height, build year or fate. The 1963 map (linked from the fan site as map1963.jpg) was viewed in the cache: it shows tower sites by type (steel 100 ft, steel 80 ft or less, wood) with no names, so it does not confirm this site by name. The fan-run still-standing list does not name a St. Williams tower, which may mean it is gone, but the list is undated and the story does not state that. Two searches found the St. Williams Forest Station history (fhso.ca, swcr.ca) but neither mentions a fire tower. Leads not yet checked: local Norfolk County historians (R. Robert Mutrie's St. Williams history) and the Forest History Society of Ontario, which may hold tower records.
